name: Teal
summary: AI career platform with a resume builder, job tracker, keyword matching and cover-letter tools to run a job search in one place.
description: AI career platform with a resume builder, job tracker, keyword matching and cover-letter tools to run a job search in one place.

pricing.details: Free Forever, no credit card required to start — 10 resume templates, Top 5 analysis in the resume builder, basic email templates per job stage, limited AI credits, basic AI resume analysis and basic resume keyword matching. Teal+ 12 € per week, or 26 € every 30 days, or 71 € every 90 days — unlimited resumes, unlimited job tracking, unlimited templates, unlimited keyword matching and advanced resume analysis, unlimited AI summaries, bullets and cover letters, full design control. You can upgrade, downgrade or cancel at any time.
